begins: on a phone, in a group of one they just made, Magnets just brought to it; their housemates are in the house chat

verdict.reason: explored, and said they were done

asked.prompt: Tell a friend how it went.

said.said: I'm on a word-magnets screen: "I can explain the ____", and anyone in the group can change the sentence for everyone. I didn't tap anything, since I'm not sure what it wants from me. Sam also wrote in the house chat: "Dinner's at 7 tomorrow, I'm cooking."

asked.prompt: What do you think this is for?

said.said: I think it's a silly game the group plays together, building a sentence from the words. It isn't asking me for anything, so I left it alone.

The odd thing was that Sam's dinner message turned up on top of a word game. It's from the house chat but sits on the magnets screen. Also, the sentence is shared, so a tap would change it for everyone, and nothing said so until I scrolled.

asked.prompt: What did you try that didn't do what you expected?

said.said: Nothing went wrong. I only looked and scrolled once. Scrolling showed more than the first look did, but nothing broke.

asked.prompt: Where did you stop, and why?

said.said: I stopped on the magnets screen, with the sentence "I can explain the ____" still blank. Tapping a word would change what everyone in the group sees, and nobody asked me to. I haven't replied to Sam either.
